title: Spectral Tail Interventions in Decoder-Only Language Models: Reasoning-Sensitive Weight Structure from Controlled Surgery
abstract: arXiv:2609.26165v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Weight-space structure often correlates with language-model behavior, but correlation alone does not establish computational involvement. We study concentrated upper spectral tails in decoder-only transformers through controlled interventions. At a fixed relative offset, we derive a finite-width conditional bound linking the inverse participation ratio of squared singular values to central pre-softmax logit kurtosis. We then define a pointwise query--key ($QK$) product-tail target and compare independent factor surgery with a product-targeted factorization that preserves native attention computation. Across three base checkpoints and five reasoning benchmarks, plus an instruction-tuned Phi checkpoint analyzed separately, the learned-tail edit is more damaging than the mean of five fixed spectrum-matched Haar controls in all 20 model--task cells. Eighteen paired contrasts remain significant after Holm correction, while two are directional

translated_title: 仅解码器语言模型中的谱尾部干预：通过受控手术揭示的推理敏感权重结构
translated_abstract: 权重空间结构通常与语言模型行为相关，但仅凭相关性并不能确立其计算上的参与作用。我们通过受控干预研究仅解码器Transformer中集中的上谱尾部。在固定相对偏移下，我们推导出一个有限宽度条件界，将平方奇异值的逆参与比与softmax前中心logit峰度联系起来。随后我们定义一个逐点的查询-键（QK）乘积尾部目标，并将独立因子手术与保留原生注意力计算的乘积目标化因子分解进行比较。在三个基础模型检查点和五个推理基准上，外加一个单独分析的指令微调Phi检查点，学习到的尾部编辑在全部20个模型-任务单元中都比五个固定谱匹配Haar随机控制的平均值更具破坏性。经Holm校正后，18个配对对比仍保持统计显著，其余两个呈方向性趋势。
tldr: 本文通过受控权重手术证明，仅解码器语言模型中与集中上谱尾部相关的QK乘积结构对推理任务具有因果性计算作用，其破坏效果在所有模型-任务组合中均显著超过谱匹配的随机对照。
en_tdlr: Through controlled weight-surgery experiments, this paper establishes that the QK product structure associated with concentrated upper spectral tails in decoder-only language models causally supports reasoning, inflicting significantly more damage than spectrum-matched random controls across all model-task combinations.
